official_gis.provider: Purdue University campus GIS ArcGIS FeatureServer, BuildingShapesZip4 layer 0
official_gis.source_crs: EPSG:4326 response; original Purdue service uses EPSG:3857/102100 (as identified in prior project source docs)
official_gis.measurement_method: Official GIS ring transformed by project local geographic linear approximation, duplicate/collinear vertices simplified with iterative maximum local point-to-segment deviation tolerance 0.25m; horizontal origin is the original footprint bbox center.
official_gis.transform: X=(longitude - -86.9137) * 84810.6041653993 m/degree; Y=(latitude - 40.4274) * 111040.0 m/degree; Z up in meters; this is approximate project frame, not a surveyed CRS
official_gis.uncertainty: GIS service gives no survey tolerance/date; vertex accuracy and wall-to-outline association unverified; overhangs not represented.

architectural_references.published_facts: Purdue Archives says constructed 1926 for Department of Horticulture and Landscape Architecture. GIS FID232 lists 5 levels and 48m extrusion, likely includes multiple vertical classifications and does not specify public surveyed accuracy. The Purdue Events exterior photo supports red brick, repeated sash windows, a centered light-stone entrance, and a flat/corniced roof edge; no dormers are visible. Exact facade spacing and concealed roof construction remain estimates pending elevation drawings.
architectural_references.google_maps_streetview: Not directly inspected in this subtask; image sources used where cited; model detail claims limited accordingly.

revision_sources.title: Purdue Events — Horticulture Building exterior photo
revision_sources.observation: Current exterior photo shows a three-level red-brick facade with repeated sash windows, centered light-stone entry surround, and a flat/corniced roof edge; no dormers are visible. This is the Horticulture Building, not the separate Plant Growth Facility. Used to remove unsupported dormers; it does not establish concealed roof construction.

validation.reopen_check: Saved, reopened from the saved .blend in Blender 5.2.3, and rerendered from that reopened scene; stable collection, placement_origin_xy_m, geometry, materials and source-file hash checked.

notes: Removed unsupported dormers; extended repeated framed sash windows across all substantial GIS facade edges, with counts/spacing treated as estimates beyond the photographed elevation.
Strengthened the centered entry as a broad limestone portal and carried a continuous stone cornice around the roof edge; retained the photo-supported red brick and flat/corniced profile.
Kept the official Horticulture Building separate from the Plant Growth Facility/greenhouses and preserved the re-entrant GIS plan.

Added a warm schematic vestibule cue behind the glazed entry, plus a short entry walk and paired low planters. Interior room layout, site furniture, and planting placement are interpretive, not survey-derived.
